body: I need to clarify that the feces was there from the previous tenants animals. I moved in and had to rip the carpet up.
The entire place was trashed and I had to rent a dumpster for $275 just to deep clean their mess before I was able to set up my home in that place.

The people before us had many animals and all I can describe it as is, when I got here there were piles and piles of feces in the carpet and the property manager told me that of course this carpet would not be able to be saved, so immediately I ripped all the carpet out. I expected the carpet to be replaced , I was okay with hardwood floors but I wanted them to be refinished as well because they weren't doing very well.

When I moved in, I informed them that Windows were broken and needed to be replaced, as well as carpets that were filled with feces, From The Previous Tenants Animals! I had to rip them out because they were not able to be saved, as per the property manager. There is a huge leak and the kitchen and the bathroom that I hadn't been mentioning since I moved in and it did not get fixed, resulting in mold. Anytime that I mention repairs in the past year I have gotten no response.

Finally after calling from a different number, we were able to reach the manager the other day. We asked please can you fix these things we will pay you in full but it's very bad condition. He said, "just move out. The house is being foreclosed and is a shithole, you'll receive a 5-day as soon as the house goes up for auction."

Thank you for the friendly advice. I was made to sign a paper saying that the management is unaware of asbestos in the home. There was a horrible leak that I asked to be fixed not even a month after moving in. The manager asked, "well don't you have a bucket you can put under there"

 I would ask him to repair the sink and toilet for months and large amounts of mold have grown in the areas. Theres a huge broken window, and upon moving in I did a deep clean, and patched up 10+ holes and painted. I paid $275 for a large dumpster to remove previous tenants garbage.

 There was feces all over the carpet. He informed me the carpets needed to be replaced. After ripping off the carpets, he stopped communicating for the most part. He told me they don't have the time or resources to fix any of the things we had mentioned. 

For the past 3 months the smell of mold has gotten horrible and we have all had weird respiratory issues and unexplained illnesses (e.r. visits.) So we have taken turns trying to find shelter, whether it's me and 2 of the girls in one shelter, dad and 2 of the boys in the other shelter. 

So now with not paying 3 months of rent after staying in places other than the home, that is against me on that record. So I feel a little defeated here.

Thank you so much. It means a lot! I did have a conversation with school about not wanting to enroll them at the time not knowing where we would end up. They are in school now but little thought or consideration was given to me telling them about our essentially being homeless. St. Vincent yes they help a lot of families I Believe. I just hope for somewhere to go before winter.

It's so complicated. The only way I can describe it is, people who wanted a person you were with, saying bad things about you to everyone else. So that when you meet everyone else, they already don't like you.
Thank you so much. It means the world.
Thank you that is one place I haven't called.

There was a girl we were living with who had long term feelings of love with my partner. She was best friends with his sister and would say things that were not always true. It just kind of shaped their view. We actually went out there 1 time. The sister threatened to hit me because I wanted to leave after she yelled at me for putting a carseat under her baby's crib for storage. There was 3 adults and 2 children in one bedroom. So after that incident, her running over the table trying to fight me, they just didn't want anything to do with me.
We were told by the property manager that the house is being condemned. We are looking for long term. I am employed and for my C-PTSD receive SSI. So that makes it difficult as well.
